Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Glory be to You, O Allah, and Your compassion
Glory be to You, O Allah, and Exalted are You
Glory be to You, O Allah, and honor is Your garment
Glory be to You, O Allah, and greatness is Your cloak
Glory be to You, O Allah, and majesty is Your authority
Glory be to You, how Great is Your Magnificence

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ سُبِّحْتَ فِيْ الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلٰى، تَسْمَعُ وَتَرٰى مَا تَحْتَ الثَّرٰى
Translation: Glory be to You, You are glorified in the highest assembly, You hear and see what is beneath the soil
Glory be to You, You are the Witness of every secret conversation
Glory be to You, the Place of every complaint
Glory be to You, Present in every gathering
Glory be to You, the Great Hope

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ تَرٰى مَا فِيْ قَعْرِ الْمَاءِ
Translation: Glory be to You, You see what is in the depths of the water

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ تَسْمَعُ أَنْفَاسَ الْحِيْتَانِ فِيْ قُعُوْرِ الْبِحَارِ
Translation: Glory be to You, You hear the breaths of whales in the depths of the seas
Glory be to You, You know the weight of the heavens
Glory be to You, You know the weight of the earths

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ تَعْلَمُ وَزْنَ الشَّمْسِ وَ الْقَمَرِ
Translation: Glory be to You, You know the weight of the sun and the moon
Glory be to You, You know the weight of darkness and light
Glory be to You, You know the weight of the shadow and the air

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ تَعْلَمُ وَزْنَ الرِّيْحِ كَمْ هِيَ مِنْ مِثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ
Translation: Glory be to You, You know the weight of the wind, how many atoms it contains
Glory be to You, Holy, Holy, Holy

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ عَجَبًا مَنْ عَرَفَكَ كَيْفَ لَا يَخَافُكَ
Translation: Glory be to You, how strange that one who knows You does not fear You
Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You
Glory be to Allah, the Most High, the Most Great
